meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Codex 作为命令行智能体，与 Claude 并用或替代，支持工具调用与历史续接。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你 用的工具支持多智能体（如 OneCLI），想换成或搭配 OpenAI 的代码模型。
copy.tagline_en: Configure Codex as your coding agent, with tool use and session history.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use OneCLI and want to replace or pair Claude with OpenAI Codex.

howto.what: 装上后，你的助手多了一种叫 Codex 的后台大脑选择，由它负责做规划、调用工具、用 MCP 工具、读历史记录和接续对话。安装本身不会改变默认大脑，默认仍是原来的；想切换或设为新默认，需要你或操作员在配置里明确指定。
howto.when: 装好后，当操作员在某分组上运行切换命令把该组的大脑设为 codex，该组的对话就由 Codex 接管。未明确切换前，不会自动启用。

say.text: 把当前分组切换成 Codex 大脑。
say.note: 该组对话改由 Codex 处理，记忆通用。

say.text: 列出可切换的分组 ID。
say.note: 用于准备切换命令，实际切换在宿主机执行。

say.text: Codex 已安装，新分组默认也用 codex 吗？
say.note: 需操作员确认并设置环境变量后才生效。

howto.what_en: Adds Codex as an alternative agent provider alongside Claude, handling planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, and session resume. Installing only wires it in; the default provider stays unchanged until explicitly switched.
howto.when_en: After install, Codex runs for a group only after an operator switches that group to the codex provider. It does not activate by itself. New groups keep the old default unless the operator opts in.

say_en.text: Switch the current group to Codex.
say_en.note: The group then runs on Codex; memory stays shared.

say_en.text: List the group IDs I can switch.
say_en.note: Use this to target the switch command.

say_en.text: Codex is installed — default new groups to codex?
say_en.note: Requires operator confirmation and an env setting.
